name: components-backgrounds-hexagon

frames.best_why: A cluster of hexagons brightens under the cursor, the clearest view of the hover effect.

tagline: A faint honeycomb wall that lights up in patches under the cursor.
summary: A full-screen grid of flat hexagons in barely-there outline on a near-black surface. Moving the pointer across it brightens the few hexagons beneath it to a slightly lighter grey.
appearance: The frame is filled edge to edge with a repeating honeycomb of hexagons, drawn in an extremely dark grey on black so the pattern reads only faintly. Where the pointer rests, a small cluster of hexagons lifts to a lighter grey, forming a soft patch. No text or other elements sit on top.
behaviour: Each hexagon has a background that fades to a lighter grey when the pointer passes over it and eases back afterwards, so a soft trail of lit cells follows the cursor. The grid recalculates its rows and columns on window resize.
search_phrases: honeycomb pattern that reacts to mouse
use_when: A dark dashboard or product page that wants a quiet geometric texture and a small hover reward.
avoid_when: The pattern is almost invisible at this contrast, and the hover cue only exists for pointer users, never keyboard.
customise: Set the hexagon size, the gap between them and pass through any div or per-hexagon props; the clip-path shape and hover colours are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A grid of plain hexagon divs with hover background transitions; no canvas or loop.

a11y.note: The lighter cells only appear on pointer hover, so keyboard users get no cue, and the animation has no reduced-motion bypass.

issues: The hexagons are so dark they are barely distinguishable from the background.
polish_why: Clean geometry but the contrast is so low the grid almost disappears.
title: Hexagon Background
